title: Plain-English Home Assistant automations, validated before they hit the house
summary: An open-source framework lets Claude Code pull a live Home Assistant config, write YAML automations from plain-English requests, and run syntax, entity-reference and official HA validation before pushing changes back.
agent_role: Claude Code edits and validates the configuration locally; the user describes automations, reviews changes and triggers the push over SSH.

curation.rationale: Launch seed collection, researched from search results.
